title: malus domestica var. roseus
intro: Malus domestica var. roseus, commonly known as the Pink Apple, is a specific variety of the domesticated apple plant that exhibits pink or rose-colored skin. The Pink Apple has been found to possess numerous health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease, cancer, and cognitive decline. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-cancer agent, neuroprotective agent, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the Pink Apple include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
